decision_basis.schedule: Morning meeting and return drive from Bentong, with expected arrival in Kuala Lumpur around 15:00.
decision_basis.monday_dose: Monday already delivered 95 minutes at 125 W, IF 0.592, TSS 55.2, Garmin load 75.9 and aerobic TE 3.0 with no meaningful steady-state HR drift.
decision_basis.garmin_diagnosis: Low-aerobic load is now 298.4 and inside target; ACWR is 0.9 OPTIMAL. High aerobic is already above target, so Tuesday has no load-repair mandate.
decision_basis.density: Use Tuesday only as low-cost bike continuity and post-drive circulation. Protect Thursday and Saturday as the two key MTB windows.

session.title: Bentong travel-day optional circulation spin
session.purpose: Use a short post-drive spin only to restore circulation and bike-frequency continuity without adding aerobic-volume debt or reducing Thursday trail quality.

dose.fresh_gate: Before riding, run the live Garmin decision sync and require no illness, mental clarity at least 8/10, normal coordination, and legs/back that feel normal or improve with easy movement after the drive.
dose.main_set: 20-30 minutes seated at 115-125 W, RPE 2-3. Use 125 W as an absolute ceiling rather than a target to force.
dose.hard_cap: 45 minutes total. Do not repeat Monday's 60-95 minute dose.
dose.skip_branch: Skip the session if the drive creates cognitive fatigue, stiffness, abnormal leg heaviness, illness symptoms or disproportionate HR/RPE. No replacement workout is owed.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A short easy spin after prolonged driving may improve circulation and reinforce bike-specific frequency while its small cost preserves the higher-value MTB repeatability work later in the week.
execution_rules: Remain seated at a naturally comfortable cadence; no low-cadence torque, standing, tempo, intervals or sprints.
Let the first 15 minutes prove that the spin is improving the legs rather than merely accumulating time.
Use normal pre-session food and water to thirst. Carbohydrate during this short easy dose is unnecessary when normally fed.
This session is optional continuity, not a Garmin load target.

expected_result.physiology: RPE remains 2-3 with stable breathing and no meaningful same-power HR rise after warm-up.
expected_result.subjective: Legs and back feel equal or better at the finish than after the drive.
expected_result.next_day: If this session is completed, Wednesday becomes rest/absorption rather than another full Zone 2 day.

stop_rules: Stop by 15 minutes if the legs, back or mental clarity are not improving.
Reduce power or stop if fixed-power HR rises more than approximately 5 bpm above the settled reference with unchanged fan, cadence and RPE context.
Stop if RPE exceeds 3, breathing becomes disproportionate, cadence/form deteriorates, or illness, pain, dizziness or chest symptoms appear.
Do not extend beyond 45 minutes even if the session feels excellent.
